title: Ae Mere Baba Husain
body:
Bain Sakeena K The Ae Mere Baba Husain
Lut Gayi Pardes Me Ae Mere Baba Husain
Kaunsi Mujhse Khata Ho Gayi Batlaiye
Dil Se Bhulaya Mujhe Ae Mere Baba Husain
Kisse Mai Ruthugi Ab Naaz Uthayega Kaun
Mujhko Manayega Kaun Ae Mere Baba Husain
Haye Sakeena Kahan Payegi Baba Tumhe
Uth Gaye Duniya Se Tum Ae Mere Baba Husain
Bhai Jawan Chut Gaya Nannha Musafir Chuta
Koi Na Zinda Raha Ae Mere Baba Husain
